## Frequently asked questions

### Where is SMK Mahal?
18/26, Old Bank of Baroda Street, Venkatapuram, Ambattur, Chennai 600 053.

### What facilities does SMK Mahal have?
Centralised A/C hall, A/C dining hall with buffet, A/C deluxe rooms, Modern kitchen, 24-hour generator backup, 24-hour security, CCTV, Ample car parking, Near bus stand & railway station, Marriage hall, Mehandhi hall, Reception hall.

### What can we hold at SMK Mahal?
Weddings, family occasions, business conferences, seminars and lectures, Bharathanatiyam arangetrams and Margazhi music programmes.

### What are your office hours?
9 am to 6 pm on working days and Sundays.

### How do I check if SMK Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 94441 48010.
